**What the ruling binds**

- The console sidebar's auto-fold threshold stays 1416 px. No user-visible behaviour changes at any width: a 1280 px or 1366 px window keeps folding to the icon rail; the click-to-overlay and the "keep the sidebar open" preference are untouched.

- `consoleSidebarRail.width-27593.test.tsx` pins the new derivation; its sum is unchanged, so no browser measurement is required.
- Options A (1024), B (1100) and C (1376) are refused. If the maintainer later says a 1280/1366 laptop is not narrow, that is a new card, derived from the record page's two-column tier (A), not a picked number.
- On the same touch, comment only: plugin-detail `synth/recordPageColumns.ts`'s "sidebar expanded at 1280" arithmetic is corrected to the rail (48) at 1280–1415 px; no behaviour change (the tiers are container-measured).
